A '''lion''' was creature in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Grakkt]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], had a body resembling an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] lion and the head of a [[Crocodile/Legends|crocodile]].<ref name="Invasion">[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game|''Star Wars: Invasion of Theed'' Adventure Game]]</ref>
